title: Tietze extension into the closed unit ball of ℝ^N
statement: Let P, N ∈ ℕ, C ⊆ ℝ^P closed and u : ℝ^P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) continuous on C with ‖u(x)‖ ≤ 1 for every x ∈ C. Then there is a continuous w : ℝ^P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with ‖w(x)‖ ≤ 1 for every x ∈ ℝ^P and w(x) = u(x) for every x ∈ C.
lean_statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (C : Set (Eucl P)) (u : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), IsClosed C → ContinuousOn u C → (∀ x ∈ C, ‖u x‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ w : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous w ∧ (∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, w x = u x
